description: The United States Government requires hotel (lodging and conference space) from May 30 to June 3, 2026 for an ICITAP Organized Crime Roundtable 4. The lodging is for up to 30 people, which is a total of 90 nights. The conference will take place between June 1-2 2026. The request requires lodging, conference space, food and beverages, and parking.
